description:

requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license
Minimum of 2 years of experience in Labor, Delivery, Recovery, and Postpartum (LDRP) care, including nursery
At least 6 months of MedSurg experience in a hospital setting
NRP certified and Advanced Fetal Monitoring

salaryOrBonusInfo: Base rate ranges from $43.68 to $62.44 per hour, depending on experience.
